nodes.title: Reference video
widgets_values:
Limiting the reference video's longest edge reduces vision-encoding time, generation time, and VRAM use. Set the limit to 0 to keep the source resolution.

Keep the selected reference segment within MiniMax's official conditioning range of 2 to 15 seconds. QKV chunking reduces temporary VRAM peaks, but it does not replace a sensible reference resolution.

widgets_values_named.text:
通过限制视频的最长边来减少视频尺寸可以大幅度提高clip视觉编码速度与视频生成速度，并且降低显存消耗，酌情进行调整，但是由于qkv分块的存在不用过于担心爆显存，调大分辨率也没事。

限制设为0时代表不缩小分辨率。

裁切视频范围应按官方条件限制为最低两秒，最长15秒。

nodes.title: Launcher settings
widgets_values:
Recommended environment (option names vary by launcher and ComfyUI version):

• Enable the cudaMallocAsync CUDA allocator.  
• Enable asynchronous weight offloading; about two transfer streams is a practical starting point.  
• Keep pinned memory enabled and let ComfyUI size it from available system memory.  
• Enable Smart Memory Management or DynamicVRAM.  
• Prefer disabling system-memory fallback in the launcher or NVIDIA CUDA settings, so VRAM exhaustion does not silently become extremely slow execution.  
• Keep the VAE on the GPU when possible; use CPU VAE only when VRAM is genuinely insufficient.

These are recommendations, not hard node dependencies. Match the equivalent settings in your own ComfyUI build, launcher, GPU, memory capacity, and driver instead of copying option names from another bundle.

widgets_values_named.text:
推荐运行环境（参数名称可能因启动器和 ComfyUI 版本不同）：

• 启用 cudaMallocAsync 异步显存分配器  
• 启用异步权重卸载，建议约 2 个传输流  
• 保持 Pinned Memory／锁页内存开启，容量交由 ComfyUI 按系统内存自动计算  
• 启用智能显存管理或 DynamicVRAM  
• 在启动器或 NVIDIA CUDA 驱动设置中优先禁止系统内存兜底，避免显存不足后无提示地进入极慢状态  
• VAE 优先使用 GPU，显存确实不足时再改用 CPU  

以上属于推荐环境而非节点硬性依赖。请根据本机 ComfyUI、启动器、显卡显存和驱动版本核对对应设置，勿直接照搬其他整合包的参数名称。

nodes.title: Live Preview
widgets_values:
Live Preview uses taeh3.safetensors from ComfyUI\models\vae_approx. The node includes automatic download, but manual installation is the reliable fallback when network access fails.

Preview overhead is small but not zero. Reduce its sample count or resolution, disable its display switch, or bypass the node when preview is unnecessary.

widgets_values_named.text:
使用该轻量化预览节点需要下载taeh3.safetensors模型放置ComfyUI\models\vae_approx文件夹内

已内置运行自动下载，但是可能会失败，手动下载放置更稳妥。

该预览节点性能消耗非常轻微但不是没有，可以自行降低参数或者直接绕过。

nodes.title: Prompt guidance
widgets_values:
Prompt quality directly affects shot structure, motion, subject consistency, and sound design. An AI assistant can follow MiniMax's official Skill to draft the prompt; provide the reference image or video as well so it can describe the source accurately.

Official Skill:
https://github.com/MiniMax-AI/MiniMax-H3/tree/main/skills

widgets_values_named.text:
提示词的书写尤为重要，可以让ai参考官方的skills进行提示词创作，记得将参考也上传给ai。

官方skills：
https://github.com/MiniMax-AI/MiniMax-H3/tree/main/skills

nodes.title: Workflow export
widgets_values:
The export node can embed the workflow directly in the video. Dropping that video onto Prompt Load later restores the prompt used for generation.

Messaging and social platforms may recompress videos and remove embedded metadata, so send the original file when the workflow must be preserved. Video only does not write workflow metadata.

Video + workflow PNG also creates a compact workflow PNG using the first video frame as its cover, which is useful as a visual workflow template card.

widgets_values_named.text:
该选项可以自动将工作流内置保存在视频中，后续通过该节点生成的视频可以拖动到提示词载入节点处来快速导入当时使用的提示词。

注意保存的工作流视频如果通过微信等方式发送会导致被压缩而失去内置工作流。使用仅视频时将不会保存工作流。

还可以使用视频+工作流png来保存一张带有第一帧视频图片的工作流图片，占用存储小可以当做可视化工作流模板卡。

nodes.title: Reference image
widgets_values:
The maximum-long-edge limit reduces reference-image resolution, vision-encoding time, and VRAM pressure.

For first/last-frame conditioning, enable aspect-ratio adjustment and select the generated video's ratio to avoid distortion. Ordinary image references do not require forced cropping.

widgets_values_named.text:
通过最长边限制降低参考图大小可以提升生成速度和降低显存压力。

如果作为首尾帧参考，需要点击调整比例将图片裁切为和生成比例相同否则会有变形。如果是参考生成视频则无需考虑。

nodes.title: Model loading and precision protection
widgets_values:
This workflow uses MiniMax H3 FP16 Exact Loader - Star7. It selects protected FP16 on SM75 and safe BF16 on SM80+, and corrects unsafe launcher-forced FP16 settings when possible.

Model mirror: https://pan.quark.cn/s/27f28ba550dc

Install missing nodes through ComfyUI Manager:
https://github.com/star7code/minimax-h3-chunk-star7.git

https://github.com/star7code/minimax-h3-fp16-exact-star7.git

widgets_values_named.text:
20系以及不支持bf16的需要启用该loader修复节点，优化内容可跳转github查看详情。新版架构显卡可以使用comfyui默认unet加载器加载模型。新版加载器已兼容新架构显卡，注意检查自己的启动器参数不要开启fp16，否则会产生溢出错误。其他修复节点也可能会导致不兼容的现象。

模型链接：https://pan.quark.cn/s/27f28ba550dc

缺失节点请在管理器中安装，便于下次更新：

https://github.com/star7code/minimax-h3-chunk-star7.git

https://github.com/star7code/minimax-h3-fp16-exact-star7.git

nodes.title: LoRA compatibility
widgets_values:
The original LarryVRH minimax_h3_turbo_v4_step600 requires the author's dedicated LoRA loader. The minimax_h3_turbo_v4_step600_comfyui_T8-convert variant works with ComfyUI's standard LoRA loader.

A full-model LoRA may include layers that do not exist in a pruned checkpoint; the current chunk node applies compatible layers without flooding the log.

Use the Sigma Shift values published with the LoRA. Common starting points are 6 / 3 for 4-step LoRAs and 12 / 3 for 8-step LoRAs. Bypass Sigma Shift to restore the default 12 / 3 behavior.

widgets_values_named.text:
对于目前的测试来说，larryvrh的minimax_h3_turbo_v4_step600对于真实人物的油腻感较轻，更为自然，但是需要使用这个作者的专用lora加载器加载该lora，否则画面会模糊崩坏。也可以使用网盘中的minimax_h3_turbo_v4_step600_comfyui_T8-convert转化版直接用comfyui的lora加载器进行加载，无需使用特殊lora加载器。

之前使用v4_step600日志中的报错是由于该lora匹配完整版模型，使用剪枝模型时由于部分模块无法对应产生报错，最新版已经兼容该问题。

Sigma Shift需要根据不同lora设定的进行改动，大部分情况4步lora为 6 / 3 ,8步为 12 / 3 ，绕过节点即可恢复默认 12 / 3 ，以实际lora公布参数为主。

nodes.title: Sigma Shift and chunk acceleration
widgets_values:
The attention path must match the GPU architecture: use an SM75 path on RTX 20-series GPUs and an SM80+ path on newer GPUs. CK is the general baseline. Select existing when another upstream node already owns attention acceleration.

CK offers the strongest quality baseline, Sol is a balanced option, and SLA prioritizes speed. Hybrid combines CK and a sparse path on complete sampling steps.

8192 is a practical starting point for the chunk controls. Attention output memory protection defaults to Off; enable it only for unusually long sequences that otherwise run out of VRAM, because it may reduce speed.

widgets_values_named.text:
注意力加速切记按照自己的显卡选择，20系选择sm75系列，这个是为了20系专门预编译好的。新架构选择sm80+，ck是通用的，或者选择existing然后在前面自行连接kjsage等注意力加速节点。

注意力选择中ck质量最佳、sol其次、sla一般，但是速度会大幅度提升，高负载情况下尤为明显。在1.0MP分辨率、10秒、4步lora、参考图生视频参数下分别为620秒、442秒、350秒。使用hybird混合注意力可平衡速度与质量。

对于2080ti 22g显卡三个参数保持8192即可，显存未占满并不会影响速度。如果在超高参数下遇到爆显存的情况（如2.0 10秒）可以开启输出显存保护，默认关闭，开启可能会导致降速。

widgets_values:
integrated_multimodal_description:

[Shot 1] Live-action, photorealistic outdoor video, 10 seconds, one continuous take.

Clean cinematic live-action photography with a completely text-free visual frame throughout the entire shot. Spoken dialogue exists only as synchronized natural voice audio. The image remains purely photographic with no graphic overlays.

A young woman stands in a bright, spacious modern outdoor architectural walkway during daytime. Large white concrete walls, clean geometric structures, a wide gray paved floor, and a long straight open corridor extend deep into the background. The corridor is spacious, level, and unobstructed, allowing her to continuously step backward for a long distance.

The woman wears a fitted light-gray long-sleeve high-neck top, a dark gray ankle-length fitted skirt, black strappy high-heeled sandals, and carries a dark brown leather handbag. Her dark hair is tied back with a large white ribbon. Natural daylight creates soft realistic shadows and a clean bright atmosphere.

The camera is positioned directly in front of her at approximately chest-to-eye level.

The camera holds one completely static full-body wide shot for the entire 10 seconds. Its position, height, optical axis, focal length, angle, and framing remain unchanged from beginning to end.

At the beginning, the woman stands relatively close to the camera with her entire body visible from head to feet.

She is squarely front-facing toward the lens.

Her face points directly toward the camera.
Her eyes look directly into the lens.
Her shoulders and chest are square to the camera.
The front side of her body is clearly visible.

She naturally says:

<d>[Chinese] 你就站那别动。</d>

Her sentence is heard only as natural synchronized speech audio while the visual frame remains clean, photographic, and text-free.

Immediately after finishing the sentence, she begins a continuous FRONT-FACING BACKWARD WALK.

She keeps facing the camera while physically traveling backward along the corridor toward the distant background.

Her movement is a clear natural reverse walking gait:

one foot reaches backward behind her body and accepts her weight;
then the other foot reaches backward behind her body;
she repeats this alternating backward stepping pattern continuously.

Each step moves her farther from the stationary camera.

Her face, shoulders, chest, and torso preserve the same frontal orientation toward the lens throughout the backward movement.

She maintains direct eye contact with the camera while stepping backward.

Her head remains naturally aligned toward the lens.

Her upper body stays square to the camera while her legs perform repeated backward steps.

The motion is steady, controlled, continuous, and physically believable for a woman wearing high-heeled sandals.

0–2 seconds:
The woman stands in the foreground, full body visible, facing directly toward the camera. She looks into the lens and delivers the dialogue.

2–4 seconds:
Immediately after speaking, she begins alternating backward footsteps. Her body starts translating deeper into the corridor while her frontal orientation toward the camera remains unchanged.

4–7 seconds:
She continues the same steady front-facing backward walking pattern in a straight line. Each alternating backward step increases her physical distance from the camera. Her entire body gradually becomes smaller in the frame through natural perspective.

7–10 seconds:
She continues stepping backward continuously toward the far background. She becomes increasingly distant and visibly smaller while still presenting the front side of her body toward the camera.

The backward gait remains visually readable throughout the shot: her feet repeatedly travel backward behind her body, her weight shifts naturally from one backward step to the next, and her physical position moves progressively deeper into the corridor.

Her handbag makes subtle natural swinging movements caused by her backward steps. Her skirt and clothing respond realistically to her leg motion and light outdoor air. Her arms and upper body make small natural balance adjustments while maintaining a clearly frontal overall orientation.

The camera remains stationary and allows the increasing distance to happen entirely through her physical backward movement.

The perspective change is natural and continuous:

at the beginning, her full body occupies a large portion of the frame;

after several backward steps, she is clearly farther away and moderately smaller;

during the final seconds, she continues moving deeper into the corridor and becomes very small in the frame.

Her apparent size reduction is produced entirely by increasing physical distance from the fixed camera.

At the final frame, the woman is far in the background and small in the image. The front side of her body is still oriented toward the camera, and her face is still directed toward the lens.

Her facial identity remains visually consistent throughout the entire distance change. The same woman, same facial structure, same hairstyle, same white ribbon, same clothing, same handbag, and same body proportions persist continuously from foreground to distant background.

The entire shot presents one simple continuous action:

the woman faces the stationary camera, speaks once, then repeatedly steps backward in a straight line while continuing to face the camera until the final frame.

Visual priority:
continuous front-facing backward walking;
alternating backward footsteps;
frontal face and torso orientation toward the lens;
steadily increasing physical distance;
natural perspective scale reduction;
completely static camera;
stable character identity;
clean text-free photographic imagery.

overall_soundscape:

Natural daytime outdoor ambience with subtle wind and distant environmental sounds. Clear synchronized female speech at the beginning. After speaking, realistic high-heeled footsteps contact the paved ground in a steady backward-walking rhythm. The footsteps gradually become quieter and more distant as she moves deeper into the corridor. Subtle handbag and clothing movement sounds remain natural.

non_diegetic_music:

N/A

nodes.title: Face restoration
widgets_values:
The face-restoration node includes video VAE decoding. Keep the node connected; with Enable restoration off it behaves as the ordinary VAE path. Restoration is disabled by default because it adds a second sampling pass and can take substantial time. Lowering the restoration size improves speed at the cost of detail, and each additional face adds another restoration pass.

Required detector model: face_yolov8m.pt
Place it in ComfyUI/models/ultralytics/bbox.

widgets_values_named.text:
为简化节点该节点直接集成视频vae节点，关闭修复按钮即可作为单独vae节点使用，因此不要绕过该节点，但是可以使用原vae节点替换。修复按钮默认为关闭状态需要使用自行开启，比较耗时间。可以降低修复尺寸以提高速度，但是质量也会相应降低。增加修复人脸的数量时间也是成倍增加的，因为是一轮一轮进行的。

使用该修复人脸节点需要下载face_yolov8m.pt模型

放置于ComfyUI/models/ultralytics/bbox文件夹内
